sentences.en: The architect boasted that he had received a prestigious award.
sentences.zh: 这位建筑师夸耀说他获得了重要奖项。

sentences.en: For most architects, such a skyscraper represents a design challenge.
sentences.zh: 对大多数建筑师来说，这样的摩天大楼都是一项设计挑战。

sentences.en: This is the house which was designed by a famous architect.
sentences.zh: 这栋房子是由一位著名建筑师设计的。

senses.zh: 建筑师；设计师；缔造者；创造者
